title: blacklist/<platform>.json — app uuids withheld from a platform's catalogs (D-25)
description: Build-time INPUT consumed by tools/build_catalog.py. One file per platform, named after the platform id, covering EVERY release channel of that platform: an app pulled for a defect has to leave stable, test and dev at once. A missing file means nothing is blocked. Not loaded by the UI, and it removes nothing that is already on a device: it only keeps the uuid out of the next build.

platform.description: Platform id. Must match platforms.json and the filename; the build rejects a mismatch.

blocked.description: Blocked apps. Empty means the platform has nothing withheld.

uuid.description: The app uuid to withhold, copied exactly from the origin's apps.json. Matched exactly and case-sensitively, so a typo blocks nothing. Check the removal count the build logs.

name.description: The app's name, as a human-readable label for the uuid. Optional, purely for reference: the build matches on uuid alone, never on this, and it is not checked against the app's real name. Worth filling in, because an app pulled today may be gone from its origin entirely by the time someone reads this entry, leaving the uuid meaning nothing.

reason.description: Why it was pulled. Free text, written for whoever reads this file months later deciding whether it can come back.
